unlisted_practices: Local deployment of an open-weight LLM through a local runtime rather than a cloud API
Single-retry handling of output parsing failures
Controlling model quantization, sampling temperature and runtime version for reproducibility
Independently reviewed reference set of 400 reports with reviewer blinding and file separation

screen.reason: Empirical study describing and evaluating an implementation pipeline of a locally hosted open-source LLM (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct) for structured classification on a retrospective dataset of 10,222 radiology reports, but it does not compare outcomes with/without a deployment safeguard or practice.
